definitions.explanation: A rice cooker mode that shortens the cycle by skipping most of the soaking time. The rice is ready in roughly half the usual time, at some cost to texture.

examples.japanese: {早炊|はやだ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧。
examples.english: I cook it on the quick setting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{早炊|はやだ}き⟦モード→モード：11596_moodo⟧にした。
examples.english: I was short of time, so I set it to quick-cook mode.

examples.japanese: {早炊|はやだ}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二十分|にじゅっぷん}ほど⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炊|た}き{上|あ}がる→炊き上がる：21619_takiagaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{炊|た}いた→炊く：02127_taku⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Quick-cook is done in about twenty minutes, but rice tastes better cooked normally.

notes:
⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ (fast) + ⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧ (to cook rice), with rendaku making たき into だき. It appears as a button label on almost every Japanese rice cooker.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早炊|はやだ}き⟦モード→モード：11596_moodo⟧: quick-cook mode
- {早炊|はやだ}き⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧: quick-cook function
- {早炊|はやだ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧: to cook on the quick setting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {炊|た}き{込|こ}み: cooking rice together with other ingredients — a different kind of setting entirely
- ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦{炊飯|すいはん}→炊飯：13377_suihan⟧: timer cooking — set to finish at a chosen time
